stories.title: North Wales Police stop 40 vehicles in food delivery driver crackdown
stories.summary: North Wales Police stopped around 40 vehicles in a crackdown on food delivery drivers. The operation ran on Friday night as part of the force’s Roads Crime Unit enforcement activity. Nine drivers were reported for having no insurance. Seven vehicles were seized. One driver was reported for driving otherwise than in accordance with a licence.

stories.title: Over half of Wales GPs say they cannot meet patient demand, BMA survey finds
stories.summary: More than half of GPs in Wales say they routinely cannot meet patient demand, according to a survey by the British Medical Association. The BMA Cymru Wales Workforce, Workload and Wellbeing Survey, which has run since 2023, took responses from 221 GPs across Wales. 54% of those surveyed described patient access as routinely inadequate. stories.summary: Residents in Northop Hall, Sychdyn and New Brighton due a brown bin collection today are being told it will now take place this evening instead. stories.title: Heatwave to continue in North Wales with little rain forecast this week
stories.summary: Flintshire is set for a run of hot, dry weather this week, with temperatures in Hawarden forecast to peak at 29C on Wednesday. The Met Office forecast highs of 27C on Monday, rising to 28C on Tuesday and 29C on Wednesday, before easing to 26C on Friday and 22C by Saturday as cloudier conditions return.
